scope: Minimal final source art: nine unchanged snapshots from the unique ordinary six-round QA integration and one512px icon. No new Model step, fixture, runtime/DOM layout replay, video, physical device or browser-earned outcome claim.

measurementLimitations.sourceSnapshots: Nine unchanged public snapshots were reused from the unique six-round ordinary QA Model integration. They are rendered source canvases, not new gameplay, actual browser-earned outcomes or forced-state fixtures.
measurementLimitations.layouts: No runtime/DOM menu, pause or settlement corpus was repeated. Actual960/1280 UI acceptance belongs to separate candidate/final QA.
measurementLimitations.hardware: Draw/upload measurements use headless Chromium SwiftShader WebGL1; no physical TV/GPU/phone performance claim.
measurementLimitations.geometry: Full actual draw commands and text bounds are retained. Observable semantic checks cover flow activation, FIFO target labels and phase advice; layout, plant clarity, comfort tracks and positioning were personally judged from actual images rather than asserted by duplicating renderer formulas.
measurementLimitations.animation: Saved frames show elapsed-based applied ventilation and actual-flow droplets. This is not a continuous video or frame-time benchmark.

testProvenance.reuse: All nine public snapshots retain exact source report/file/field hashes. No Model import, predictor, clock advance, state assignment or new ordinary round is performed by art generation.
testProvenance.publicSemantics: Actual applied levels govern the greenhouse effects; positive completed-interval flow gates droplets. ACT/REQ and earliest FIFO target are checked as visible text; every crop keeps its own progress/damage while sharing global climate.
testProvenance.geometry: Commands and measured ASCII text bounds are retained. Independent visual review, not a duplicate rendering formula, establishes placement/readability.
testProvenance.purity: Deep-freeze/unchanged JSON, throwing hidden/private getters and a throwing PureModel proxy guard rendering. Arbitrary external time/input arguments leave commands/HUD/result unchanged.
testProvenance.performance: Actual GL interception recorded one1024x1024 upload and one drawElements call per case, GL0 and max464quads. Context restoration reproduces pixels.
testProvenance.deduplication: One approved source-art execution passed. Existing formal/unique ordinary/independent evidence and candidate/final DOM layouts were not repeated.
